text:
maya: seeing a 150-300ms tail in a few pods starting ~01:42 UTC, looks eviction-related. @jonas can you take a look?
jonas: saw the alert, grabbing logs. only on machines handling long-context sessions (>64k tokens) so KV churn is high.
liam: any recent kernel selection or batching changes rolled? could be interacting with eviction scheduling.
sophia: nothing major in kernel selection since last deploy, batching tweaks were minor (adaptive-window tweak).
ci-bot: monitor: latency_p90 spike on inference-runtime.kv_hits 01:42 -> 01:45, affected replica count=4
maya: attaching a short log excerpt i saw on one host: ``[evicter] schedule_rescan delayed=22ms budget=1 reacquire=true`` then a batch of requests see +200ms
jonas: interesting — looks like evicter tasks get rescheduled while a prior reclaim is completing, causing a clump of sync work. reproducer idea: drive synthetic long contexts and toggle evicter_budget.
liam: pushed a flamegraph from pprof on the hot worker: ``evicter::rescan -> kv::pager -> mutex::contention -> runtime::serve`` major stack at contention on slab arena.
sophia: that matches fragmentation: many tiny tombstones after repeated reinsert with FIFO policy, eviction scan iterates more pages. fifo vs lru tie-breaker seems to produce scan hotspots under bursty append workloads.
rafa: quick experiment: flip policy to lru_small_bucket on a canary and run replayed trace. 谁 wants to run? (i can)
maya: please run on canary-3, use trace id=2026-03-kvstress1 and capture p95/p99 for token latency and evicter_cycles.
rafa: started. also added debug flag `KV_EVICT_DEBUG=1` to log reschedule reasons.
jonas: early output: ``reschedule_reason=budget_exhausted; reschedule_count=3``. looks like the budget threshold is too small for high fragmentation.
liam: curious whether batching heuristics exacerbate this: we coalesce small generation requests into a large batch which temporarily increases KV working set, spike causes many items to cross eviction watermark simultaneously.
sophia: can we throttle batch coalescing when free_kv_pages < X? that would reduce sudden working set growth.
maya: agree, but need to be careful — throttling batching impacts latency and throughput tradeoff. propose safe short-term: increase evicter_budget from 1 -> 4 and add small jitter to rescan start to avoid synchronized reschedules.
jonas: also found a correctness smell: when an evicter reschedules mid-reclaim, it may requeue the same page with an updated timestamp but not clear the tombstone indicator, causing a reinsert attempt that spikes allocation. potential duplicate work.
rafa: logged a repro snippet: ``evict_page(id=0x7f3, state=tombstone) -> reclaim -> reschedule -> reinsert -> eviction scan sees id again``. looks like a race not deduped.
liam: that could explain transient memory growth during long contexts. repeated reinsert/reclaim churns.
sophia: mitigation plan: 1) increase budget for short window 2) add random jitter to rescan (2-10ms) 3) add fast-path dedupe check in reschedule to skip tombstones already in-flight.
maya: can we ship the budget bump as a config toggle (runtime flag) to avoid full deploy? if stable, then follow up with code fix.
jonas: yes, flag `evicter_budget=4` is easy. I'll flip on canary-3 and canary-5, run stress.
ci-bot: deploy: evicter_budget=4 toggled on canary-3 at 01:58 UTC by jonas
rafa: initial canary run shows p95 drop ~80ms, p99 drop ~160ms, evicter reschedule_count down from median 3 -> 1. promising.
liam: we should check long-term correctness — dedupe fix needs review. I'll open a small PR with the tombstone-inflight check and unit tests.
sophia: also let's add a telemetry counter for reschedule_reason and reschedule_count per pod so we can alert if reschedule_count increases > 5 in 1m.
maya: agreed. thanks all. next steps: jonas to validate canaries for 2h, liam PR + tests, sophia add telemetry + alert, rafa run wider replay. I'll post postmortem if needed. :thumbsup:
jonas: updating ticket with logs and flamegraph links: https://internal/issue/RED-evicter-4861
liam: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/evicter/pulls/189 (WIP)
sophia: alert: created alert rule `evicter.reschedule_count > 5` with severity=page.
rafa: widening replay to 6 canaries now.
maya: if canaries stay stable for 2h, we'll roll budget flag cluster-wide and schedule the dedupe fix for next patch release.
rafa: can confirm after 30m wider replay still stable. one pod had a small blip at 02:25 but reschedule_count=2 not >5.
maya: great — closing slack thread, continuing followups in ticket and PR.
